text: Rae M: Quick design review — compact 'create workspace' modal. Users want minimal chrome but we're seeing missed required fields. Proposal: keep visual compactness, but: defer inline errors until blur; show top banner on submit failures; and make required state explicit on narrow widths. Thoughts? Jonas T: Agree with deferring errors. Two practical asks: 1) the banner must be keyboard-focusable and use an aria-live region, 2) when banner focuses the first invalid field we should animate the scroll so keyboard users aren't disoriented. Ellen V: Accessibility note: a visual asterisk alone is insufficient. Add aria-required on inputs and an sr-only "required" label. On phones show a short "Required" pill after the label rather than a standalone asterisk. Rae M: Updated pattern: (A) inline errors appear on blur and persist while editing after first blur, (B) on submit show a compact banner: "We couldn't save 1 fix the highlighted fields." banner has role="alert"/aria-live="polite" and a visible focus ring, (C) permanent deletes inside modal require typed-confirm exact name; reversible removal uses toast + undo, (D) provide microcopy variants in Figma. Jonas T: Example markup for the spec: ```html ``` And add a small 150ms focus transition when moving to the first invalid input. Ellen V: Microcopy tweaks: banner -> "We couldn't save 1 please fix the highlighted fields." typed confirm prompt -> "Type the workspace name to permanently delete: ". Also include a short accessibility checklist with specific ARIA attributes and contrast specs. DesignBot: prototype-lint: found 2 inputs missing aria-required in /design/prototypes/workspace-compact. Contrast on banner CTA borderline. See PR suggestions. Rae M: Vote: :thumbsup: if you accept the pattern (blur->show; submit banner+focus+aria-live; typed-confirm for permanent deletes; toast undo for reversible). Reply with reaction. Jonas T: :thumbsup: — will add aria-live region and focus animation helper. Ellen V: :thumbsup: — will add label variants for mobile and the a11y checklist to the spec. Rae M: Thanks 1 I'll update the Figma notes with microcopy and code snippets, then open a PR with the checklist. DesignBot: spec PR #530 opened with patch and checklist.
